I wrote the three-step sign-up flow to `solution.tsx`, with its styles in `solution.css`. I couldn't run it, so none of it has been tested or viewed in a browser.

- **Kit and brands:** The page uses the Orrery kit (Card, Field, Input, Radio, Checkbox, Button). The CSS uses only token variables, so it follows whichever brand is active. It sets its own `--page` background, since the host page adds none.
- **Step indicator:** The step indicator reads "Step 1 of 3", "Step 2 of 3" and "Step 3 of 3", above the step title. Focus moves to the title when the step changes.
- **Step 1, "Your details":**
  - "Continue" checks both fields. An empty name shows "Enter your name." and an email without an @ shows "Enter a valid email.", each under its own field.
  - It doesn't advance until both pass.
